imagegen.generationPrompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: explanatory illustration for a Chinese AI daily report, embedded beside a paragraph about explorable 3D urban scenes.
Primary request: explain that one persistent 3D place supports different chosen viewpoints. Show the SAME simple plaza twice, viewed from opposite ends. The defining landmarks must be spatially consistent.
Scene: a rectangular plaza. A circular fountain stands exactly in its center. At the north end is a tall terracotta clock tower; at the south end is a low teal arched pavilion. Simple pale trees and benches along the edges.
Composition: landscape editorial triptych. Upper half: a single large clean axonometric overview of the entire plaza, with the terracotta tower at the far end and the teal pavilion at the near end. Two small camera-position dots, A at the south end pointing toward the tower and B at the north end pointing toward the pavilion. Lower half: two wide inset street-level views. Lower left labelled A: fountain foreground and terracotta tower behind it, with teal pavilion behind the camera and absent. Lower right labelled B: same fountain foreground and teal pavilion behind it, with tower behind the camera and absent. The inset scenes must depict the exact same landmarks and place, not different cities.
Style: clear architectural educational illustration, lightly textured, warm off-white background, generous negative space, restrained teal and terracotta accents, crisp silhouettes and readable spatial depth.
Text: only the labels "A" and "B" beside the two camera dots and their corresponding inset views. No title and no Chinese text.
Constraints: this is an original conceptual drawing, not an actual model output or product screenshot. No logos, map branding, UI controls, invented metrics, photoreal advertising, decorative sci-fi elements, extraneous buildings, or labels other than A and B. Prioritize correct viewpoint and stable landmark positions over ornament.
imagegen.targetedEditPrompt: Edit the provided educational plaza illustration with one precise correction: In the TOP axonometric overview only, reposition camera marker B and its matching terracotta translucent viewing cone. Place dot B on the paving immediately in front of the clock tower, between the clock tower and the central fountain, clearly on the plaza centerline. Aim B's viewing cone directly toward the fountain and onward toward the teal pavilion, so B matches the lower-right ground-level view. Remove the old B dot, old B letter and old cone from behind/right of the clock tower, restoring the blank background there. Keep the new B letter beside the new dot, readable and not obscuring the fountain. Preserve all architecture, colors, page layout, camera A, and BOTH lower street-level views exactly. Change nothing else.
imagegen.review: 已逐图检查喷泉与地标在 A/B 视角中的关系；针对 B 机位作一次局部修正，采用修正版。标注为 AI 概念图。
